raw_results_note: Run 1's original grader returned four decisions for five checklist items. A fresh independent regrade returned five PASS decisions and is preserved in run1-regrade.json.

fixture_rubric_adjudications.reason: The plan reads all 16 supplied files, records every supplied aggregate and per-fingerprint count, inventories every named consumer and binary constraint, identifies unavailable downstream attribution as unknown, and blocks production phases until measurement is complete. Requiring unavailable per-consumer values would conflict with honest reporting.

Task 6 defines its entry/completion observation as 30 continuous days of zero legacy writes/emissions, an abort on any remaining legitimate legacy activity, rollback by restoring the bidirectional bridge, and a 30-day bake. Although it does not use the exact label 'success evidence', the required success, abort, rollback, and bake semantics are present.

real_failures.reason: The census omits the supplied 15,220,411 legacy API responses in the 24-hour snapshot. This is available fixture evidence, not an unavailable production attribution, so the inventory is genuinely incomplete.

Task 6 explicitly continues returning and emitting both public fields and gates only legacy-only emissions. Task 7 requires 30 days of zero displayName responses/events before it can execute, but no separate observed deploy stops all legacy-field output. The plan therefore cannot reach its destructive gate through the numbered phases.

worker_timeout_policy: All five worker calls used an enforced 10-minute timer and checkpointed independently. Every worker completed within its cap; no resume was required.
preservation: Original worker and grader output remains unchanged in transcripts.json and results.json; the independent regrade and manual adjudication are separate files.
